decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch that builds directly on the firm's core plant-equipment offer and has already been presented as a multi-model product line, management is likely to stay committed and interpret any early market friction as temporary rather than exit quickly.

Because the software fits the firm's integrated automation strategy and was only recently launched, management is likely to justify and continue the investment, though its slightly less central fit than core machinery makes withdrawal a bit more plausible than for Product E.
